title: CyberPetsAI project overview
content: CyberPetsAI is described in the project materials as an NFT collection centered on adoptable AI-powered digital pets on Polygon. The project materials identify Digitalknuckles as creator/designer and Funfart Games as the ecosystem. The collection launched in August 2024.

title: The Breach and the Base emergence
content: In the CyberPetsAI Reboot story, corrupted companions escape the confines of Polygon through a dimensional breach and emerge on Base as unstable Glitched Artifacts. The artifacts are narrative fragments in an unfolding containment story.

title: Containment Agents
content: Containment Agents are the role-play figures tasked with locating and containing rogue CyberPetsAI companions affected by the Chaos Glitch. They use Bootkeys, the name given to CyberPetsAI Reboot NFTs, and containment artifacts called Reboot-Keys to capture, reboot, disable, or repair corrupted companions.
